description.value: The Wolf and Hound is a full-service Irish pub on Vancouver's West Broadway corridor, founded in 2002 as a tribute to the late Danny Burns — a Belfast musician and beloved figure of Vancouver's Irish diaspora. The pub carries on his legacy with live entertainment nights, a full drinks menu, brunch and dinner service, and private event bookings. A touring cyclist arriving on the Broadway corridor would find a sit-down pub atmosphere with food and drink options across several menu categories.
